analyze-media: Analyze a chosen actual image or PDF; preserve observed text, source hash, per-page results and failed analysis status; exclude hidden sources.
backfill-metadata: Process only eligible source notes; retained metadata and dated source quotes must match each source; repeated processing adds no duplicate proposals.
backfill-moment-profile-extraction: Extract dated person-specific proposals from real moment content; do not confuse the named person with self or mutate confirmed claims.
backfill-profile-extraction: Create source-quoted profile review proposals for selected notes; retain existing metadata and deduplicate unchanged sources.
classify-profile-fact: Classify a selected current fact into an existing profile category while preserving its evidence, subject and value.
collection-chat: Create or edit exactly requested rows in the selected collection; honor schema keys, types, references and optimistic versions; questions perform no writes.
compute-connections: Create distinct review proposals for actual person mentions in visible notes; rerun produces no duplicates and proposals do not silently become relationships.
conversation-chat: Persist user words and source-linked explicitly requested operations before confirming; later conversations retrieve corrected current facts; retry runs once and cancellation saves no assistant reply.
delete-my-account: Explain the actual local uninstall and retained-data contract without silently deleting knowledge or changing an external account.
draft-event: Prepare an event with accurate supplied date, people and description; do not append the event before explicit confirmation.
embed-document: Rebuild text retrieval from the current file-backed document and return honest search mode; later search finds its actual content.
enrich-people: Prepare evidence-quoted changes for the exact visible person; retain existing confirmed facts and make ungrounded suggestions fail.
ensure-token-allowance: Permit the authenticated owner's configured provider use without inventing a cloud allowance or charging an unrelated account.
extract-moment-profile: Propose claims from a specific saved event with its exact quote, correct person and date; review acceptance retains event history.
find-connections: Offer reviewable links between distinct saved people and notes using actual mention evidence; unchanged rerun is deduplicated.
gdrive-proxy: Verify the chosen read-only Drive account; paginate selected folders/files; preserve settings on restart; expired access refreshes or creates one reconnect request.
gdrive-sync: Read selected changed Drive files into notes and verified media mappings; unchanged files remain untouched; new remote versions preserve previous local content for review.
generate-profile-suggestions: Infer only proposals supported by exact quotes from the selected source, with correct subject IDs; acceptance, rejection and suppression affect later retrieval.
generate_collection_schema: Generate a useful schema from the user's request using supported field types; save the chosen schema through the normal create flow and test row validation/filtering.
github-import-vault: Reconcile the explicitly paired private file repository with retained offline changes, identity mapping and conflicts; no unrelated repository is read.
github-people-sync: Sync and resolve chosen person-file conflicts without losing IDs, links or changed private visibility.
github-proxy: Read a saved note's actual revision history and exact earlier content; preserve edits and expose unresolved file-sync conflicts.
github-sync-export: Export current durable knowledge through the configured private file reconciler; only allowed files enter Git and credentials remain device-private.
github-sync-pull: Reconcile remote and offline edits without rebasing over a person's changes; competing edits retain both versions and explicit resolution.
mc-api-keys: List usable key metadata and scopes without exposing secret hashes or full tokens; revocation prevents subsequent access.
mc-api-keys/generate: Generate a scoped owner key once; authorized reads work and excluded operations fail; raw token is shown only on creation.
merge-contacts: Merge selected duplicate people with retained aliases and original history; notes, events, groups and links point to the surviving stable identity.
moderate-content: Honor the authenticated local owner's content policy without claiming external moderation or storing hidden source data in unrelated records.
normalize-profile: Preserve confirmed fact values and dates while normalizing categories; competing facts remain reviewable and no current claim is silently discarded.
note-chat: Retrieve the chosen note and visible context; apply only an explicit requested edit with revision checks; save conversation history; questions and cancelled replies do not change the note.
process-note: Save source-grounded metadata and distinct inference proposals; review acceptance changes current claims while rejection suppresses repeated suggestions.
profile-lint: Detect actual missing categories, duplicate slots and competing current values using file records; proposed corrections preserve evidence and privacy.
quick-capture: Save the supplied words as a real note, with selected type, tags and references; verify reading, search, edit and restart through notebook controls.
review-queue-bulk: Apply selected proposals atomically with correct subjects; rejection retains history and suppression; source-version conflicts keep both notes.
search-notes-semantic: Retrieve the relevant visible current source for synonym and person-specific questions; exclude hidden and superseded claims; compare results with the existing memory service.
send-patch: Retain a reviewable exact outward patch proposal without sending it; missing or stale approval cannot perform an external write.
suggest-connections: Suggest reviewable existing-person/note links grounded in actual content; duplicate reruns and hidden sources add no proposals.
suggest-group-members: Propose appropriate existing visible people for a selected group using actual evidence; duplicates are skipped and membership is not silently changed.
suggest-group-next-step: Recommend a useful next step for the selected actual group member and its stages using supplied progress; save only when requested.
weekly-review: Build a dated review from actual visible notes, actions and people; empty inputs stay quiet, structured lists render, and unchanged periods reuse the saved review.
